source_description: Unique business identifier of the observation
comment: At least one identifier is required, including the UUID slice with system fixed to be-ns-observation-diabetes. Slicing is open, so other business identifiers can be added.

source_description: Date of encoding of the observation by the recorder

comment: observationDate[x] and effective[x] are restricted to Period; start and end are both mandatory.

source_description: The patient that this observation is about
Health professional or organization that encodes the information and takes responsibility for its content
comment: Inherited from BeClinicalObservation; restricted to Reference(BePractitioner | BeOrganization).
Bound (preferred) to BeVSDiabetesObservationCategory: the monitoring procedure, and 258090004 Calculated or 258104002 Measured.

source_description: Code corresponding to the derived value

comment: value[x] is restricted to Quantity and is mandatory.

source_description: The device used to generate the observation data
comment: Inherited from BeModelClinicalObservation and BeClinicalObservation; not constrained.

source_description: Guidance on how to interpret the value
comment: Inherited from BeModelClinicalObservation and BeClinicalObservation; not constrained. Out of scope for the derived diabetes observation.
